00090 template <class XFadeTextureEventType, class OwnerType>
00091 class XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal : public XFadeTextureUGenInternal
00092 {
00093 public:
00094     XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00095                                   const float transitionTime,
00096                                   const int numChannels, 
00097                                   const int maxRepeats,
00098                                   OwnerType* o) throw()
00099     :   XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00100         event_(o)
00101     { 
00102     }
00103     
00104     XFadeTextureEventUGenInternal(const float sustainTime,
00105                                   const float transitionTime,
00106                                   const int numChannels, 
00107                                   const int maxRepeats,
00108                                   XFadeTextureEventType const& e) throw()
00109     :   XFadeTextureUGenInternal(sustainTime, transitionTime, numChannels, maxRepeats), 
00110         event_(e)
00111     { 
00112     }
00113 
00114     UGen spawnEvent(SpawnUGenInternal& spawn, const int eventCount) throw()
00115     {
00116         UGen event = event_.spawnEvent(*this, eventCount);
00117         spawn.nextTime = transitionTime + sustainTime;
00118         Env env(Buffer(0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0), 
00119                 Buffer(transitionTime, sustainTime, transitionTime), 
00120                 EnvCurve::Welch);
00121         return event * EnvGen::KR(env, UGen::DeleteWhenDone);
00122     }
00123 
00124 protected:
00125     XFadeTextureEventType event_;
00126 };

00462 template <class TrigXFadeEventType, class OwnerType>
00463 class TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal : public TrigXFadeUGenInternal
00464 {
00465 public:
00466     TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal(const int numChannels,
00467                                       UGen const& trig,
00468                                       const float transitionTime,
00469                                       const int maxRepeats,
00470                                       OwnerType* o) throw()
00471     :   TrigXFadeUGenInternal(numChannels, trig, transitionTime, maxRepeats), 
00472         event_(o)
00473     { 
00474     }
00475     
00476     TrigXFadeEventUGenInternal(const int numChannels,
00477                                       UGen const& trig,
00478                                       const float transitionTime,
00479                                       const int maxRepeats,
00480                                       TrigXFadeEventType const& e) throw()
00481     :   TrigXFadeUGenInternal(numChannels, trig, transitionTime, maxRepeats), 
00482         event_(e)
00483     { 
00484     }
00485 
00486     UGen spawnEvent(TSpawnUGenInternal& spawn, const int eventCount, void* extraArgs = 0)
00487     {
00488         events.release();
00489         UGen event = event_.spawnEvent(*this, eventCount, extraArgs);
00490         Env env(Buffer(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), 
00491                 Buffer(transitionTime, transitionTime), 
00492                 EnvCurve::Welch, 1);
00493         return event * EnvGen::KR(env, UGen::DeleteWhenDone);
00494     }

00496 protected:

00498 };
